title: Tim Dooley — FAFO / FAFO Army Prediction Audit — Wave 21
status: research cluster; no strict FAFO prediction promoted yet
purpose: Audit whether Tim Dooley made a genuinely pre-event prediction about FAFO, a Canadian citizen/reserve army, FAFO becoming geopolitical, or FAFO becoming part of the North Axis. Separate pre-event prediction evidence from later mythic/explanatory use of FAFO.

core_chronology.event: A Canadian Chief of the Defence Staff / Deputy Minister directive initiated planning connected to Reserve Force transformation. Later official briefing material says the 300,000 figure was an aspirational target for the Supplementary Reserve or other forms of reserve service.
Ottawa Citizen publicly reported Canadian military planning around a supplementary-reserve expansion of up to roughly 300,000.
Meidas Canada published an episode explicitly framing Canada's proposed 300,000-person citizen/reserve expansion as 'Canada Defies Trump With Citizen's Army - FAFO !!!'.

core_chronology.status: interesting cultural diagnosis, but too late to count as predicting FAFO's entry into political/geopolitical language because public political/military FAFO usage already existed.

current_assessment.why: No recovered Tim source currently predates the relevant Canadian reserve planning/public reporting strongly enough to claim that Tim predicted the 300,000-person Canadian reserve concept or the later public 'FAFO citizen army' framing.
current_assessment.useful_existing_signal: The May 12, 2026 subculture-to-geopolitics statement is a real Tim diagnosis but is not chronologically early enough to establish FAFO's political/geopolitical emergence as a successful prediction.
current_assessment.important_nonprediction: Later statements connecting FAFO Army, Canada, Europe and the North Axis are valuable for project history and for freezing future subclaims, but must not be backdated into forecasts.

highest_value_recovery_targets.target: pre-2025-05-30 Tim statement about Canada building a citizen/reserve/mobilization force
highest_value_recovery_targets.upgrade_if_found: Potential strong explicit prediction because it would precede the internal Canadian planning baseline.

highest_value_recovery_targets.target: pre-2025-11-10 Tim statement predicting a very large Canadian reserve/citizen army, especially with an approximate number
highest_value_recovery_targets.upgrade_if_found: Potential public-knowledge foresight case; strongest if it also predates the May 30 internal directive.

highest_value_recovery_targets.target: pre-2025-12-13 Tim use of FAFO specifically as a Canadian geopolitical/defence force
highest_value_recovery_targets.upgrade_if_found: Could establish precedence for the later public 'Canada citizen army — FAFO' framing, though common prior FAFO political usage must still be considered.

highest_value_recovery_targets.target: older Tim statements that online/subcultural movements would become geopolitical actors or quasi-armies
highest_value_recovery_targets.upgrade_if_found: Could support a broader cultural-foresight case independent of the Canadian reserve story.

future_freeze_points: If Tim predicts a specific growth figure for the FAFO community after 2026-09-17, record the number and deadline before checking the outcome.
If Tim predicts FAFO becoming formally linked to a Canadian political, civic-resilience, reserve, or defence institution, define the institution and event criterion first.
If Tim predicts a Canada-Europe/North security development through FAFO language, score the external security development separately from the mythic FAFO interpretation.
